dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}! It really is — seriously, I slept like a baby last night, so I am feeling prett-tay pumped this morning!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So, what're you up to today, huh? Need my help with anything? Whatever it is, just say the word and Itto is on the case!
